summary: Verified web app stability after ScreenCaptureLock + ShakeGuard additions to _layout.tsx. App loads without crash, login flow works, tabs navigate correctly. No expo-screen-capture or accelerometer errors on web.
critical_code_review_comments: ScreenCaptureLock correctly returns null on web (Platform.OS === 'web') — no UnavailabilityError
ShakeGuard correctly passes enabled: Platform.OS !== 'web' to useShakeDetector — no Accelerometer crash on web
Zero JS console errors observed during full login and navigation flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Privacy features (ScreenCaptureLock, ShakeGuard) are properly web-guarded. Full login flow verified: language selector → consent (testIDs: consent-age-adult, consent-terms-checkbox, consent-data-checkbox, consent-continue-button) → login (testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button) → home screen → all 5 tabs (tab-home, tab-rights, tab-ask, tab-myfiles, tab-me) navigating correctly.
rca_of_issue: N/A — fix confirmed working. expo-screen-capture was crashing web because usePreventScreenCapture() was being called on web. Fix: ScreenCaptureLock returns null on web; _NativeCaptureLock (containing the hook) only renders on native.
